package app_test

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql"
	"github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql/handler"
	"github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql/handler/extension"
	"github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql/handler/transport"
	"github.com/vektah/gqlparser/v2"
	_ "modernc.org/sqlite"

	"example.com/app/graph"
	"github.com/syssam/velox"
	"github.com/syssam/velox/contrib/graphql/veloxgql"
	"github.com/syssam/velox/contrib/graphql/veloxgql/gqlgenx"
)

// n is the number of entities: scale_e2e_test.go writes it.
const n = __N__

// graphiQL is the query GraphiQL and most clients send for the schema.
const graphiQL = `query IntrospectionQuery {
	__schema {
		queryType { name }
		mutationType { name }
		subscriptionType { name }
		types { ...FullType }
		directives { name description locations args { ...InputValue } }
	}
}
fragment FullType on __Type {
	kind name description
	fields(includeDeprecated: true) { name description args { ...InputValue } type { ...TypeRef } isDeprecated deprecationReason }
	inputFields { ...InputValue }
	interfaces { ...TypeRef }
	enumValues(includeDeprecated: true) { name description isDeprecated deprecationReason }
	possibleTypes { ...TypeRef }
}
fragment InputValue on __InputValue { name description type { ...TypeRef } defaultValue }
fragment TypeRef on __Type {
	kind name
	ofType { kind name ofType { kind name ofType { kind name ofType { kind name ofType { kind name ofType { kind name ofType { kind name } } } } } } }
}`

type served struct {
	t   *testing.T
	do  func(query string, vars map[string]any) string
	sql *sql.DB
}

// serve is the schema on a seeded in-memory database, through gqlgen's handler
// and the cost limit of a DB opened with these options.
func serve(t *testing.T, opts ...velox.Option) served {
	t.Helper()
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite", "file::memory:?_pragma=foreign_keys(0)")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = db.Close() })
	db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
	tx, err := db.Begin()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, s := range ddl {
		if _, err := tx.Exec(s); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", s, err)
		}
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	vdb := velox.Open(velox.SQLite, db, opts...)
	srv := handler.New(graph.NewExecutableSchema(graph.Config{Resolvers: &graph.Resolver{DB: vdb}}))
	srv.Use(gqlgenx.CostLimit(vdb))
	srv.AddTransport(transport.POST{})
	srv.Use(extension.Introspection{})
	do := func(query string, vars map[string]any) string {
		t.Helper()
		b, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"query": query, "variables": vars})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/", strings.NewReader(string(b)))
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		srv.ServeHTTP(w, req)
		return w.Body.String()
	}
	return served{t, do, db}
}

func (s served) want(name, query, want string) {
	s.t.Helper()
	if got := s.do(query, nil); got != want {
		s.t.Errorf("%s:\ngot  %s\nwant %s", name, got, want)
	}
}

// schema is the executable schema's, for Cost.
func schema() graphql.ExecutableSchema {
	return graph.NewExecutableSchema(graph.Config{Resolvers: &graph.Resolver{}})
}

func TestLargeSchemaTypes(t *testing.T) {
	start := time.Now()
	s := serve(t)
	t.Logf("%d entities: schema, tables and handler in %v", n, time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
	start = time.Now()
	if got := s.do("{ __typename }", nil); got != `{"data":{"__typename":"Query"}}` {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
	t.Logf("first request %v", time.Since(start).Round(time.Microsecond))

	var all struct {
		Data struct {
			Query struct{ Fields []struct{ Name string } }
			Schema struct{ Types []struct{ Name string } }
		}
	}
	got := s.do(`{ Query: __type(name: "Query") { fields { name } } Schema: __schema { types { name } } }`, nil)
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(got), &all); err != nil || strings.Contains(got, "errors") {
		t.Fatalf("%v: %.300s", err, got)
	}
	fields := map[string]bool{}
	for _, f := range all.Data.Query.Fields {
		fields[f.Name] = true
	}
	types := map[string]bool{}
	for _, ty := range all.Data.Schema.Types {
		types[ty.Name] = true
	}
	for i := range n {
		if f := fmt.Sprintf("e%ds", i); !fields[f] {
			t.Errorf("Query has no %s", f)
		}
		for _, suffix := range []string{"", "Connection", "Edge", "Order", "OrderField", "WhereInput"} {
			if name := fmt.Sprintf("E%d%s", i, suffix); !types[name] {
				t.Errorf("no type %s", name)
			}
		}
	}
	t.Logf("%d types, %d root fields", len(types), len(fields))
}

// TestLargeSchemaIntrospection: GraphiQL's query is admitted under
// MaxIntrospectionCost exactly when Cost says it fits, and with the limit
// raised to its cost the schema answers it whole, in bounded time and memory.
func TestLargeSchemaIntrospection(t *testing.T) {
	es := schema()
	doc, errs := gqlparser.LoadQueryWithRules(es.Schema(), graphiQL, nil)
	if len(errs) > 0 {
		t.Fatal(errs)
	}
	def := veloxgql.DefaultLimits()
	cost := gqlgenx.Cost(es.Schema(), doc.Operations[0], nil, veloxgql.Limits{MaxIntrospectionCost: 1 << 40})
	fits := cost <= def.MaxIntrospectionCost
	t.Logf("%d entities: GraphiQL's query costs %d, the default limit is %d (fits: %v)", n, cost, def.MaxIntrospectionCost, fits)

	got := serve(t).do(graphiQL, nil)
	switch refused := strings.Contains(got, "COST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED"); {
	case fits && refused, !fits && !refused:
		t.Errorf("fits %v under the default limit, but the response is %.300s", fits, got)
	case fits && strings.Contains(got, `"errors"`):
		t.Errorf("errors: %.300s", got)
	}

	// The limit is exact: one under the cost refuses the query, and no data comes back.
	tight := serve(t, veloxgql.WithLimits(veloxgql.Limits{MaxIntrospectionCost: cost - 1})).do(graphiQL, nil)
	if !strings.Contains(tight, "COST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED") || strings.Contains(tight, `"types"`) {
		t.Errorf("a limit of %d under a cost of %d: %.300s", cost-1, cost, tight)
	}

	s := serve(t, veloxgql.WithLimits(veloxgql.Limits{MaxIntrospectionCost: cost}))
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
	start := time.Now()
	got = s.do(graphiQL, nil)
	elapsed := time.Since(start)
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
	if strings.Contains(got, `"errors"`) {
		t.Fatalf("with the limit at its cost: %.300s", got)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{fmt.Sprintf(`"name":"E%dWhereInput"`, n-1), `"name":"E0Connection"`} {
		if !strings.Contains(got, want) {
			t.Errorf("no %s in the answer", want)
		}
	}
	alloc := after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc
	t.Logf("introspection: %v, %d KB answer, %d MB allocated, %d bytes a unit", elapsed.Round(time.Millisecond), len(got)/1024, alloc>>20, alloc/uint64(cost))
	// Measured 830 to 950 bytes a unit from 10 to 500 entities, falling as the
	// schema grows. decision 0027's 640 is the worst case, a flood of aliases of
	// this query. The bound allows twice the measure and fails a walk that grows
	// with the schema's size.
	if per := alloc / uint64(cost); per > 2048 {
		t.Errorf("%d bytes allocated for each unit of cost, measured about 900", per)
	}
	if elapsed > time.Minute {
		t.Errorf("introspection took %v", elapsed)
	}
}

func TestLargeSchemaQueries(t *testing.T) {
	s := serve(t)
	last := n - 1
	s.want("first entity", `{ e0s(first: 2) { totalCount edges { node { name amount } } } }`,
		`{"data":{"e0s":{"totalCount":3,"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e0-r1","amount":1.5}},{"node":{"name":"e0-r2","amount":2.5}}]}}}`)
	s.want("last entity, ordered", fmt.Sprintf(`{ e%ds(first: 1, orderBy: {field: NAME, direction: DESC}) { edges { node { name } } } }`, last),
		fmt.Sprintf(`{"data":{"e%ds":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e%d-r3"}}]}}}`, last, last))
	mid := n / 2
	s.want("where", fmt.Sprintf(`{ e%ds(where: {name: "e%d-r2"}) { edges { node { name } } } }`, mid, mid),
		fmt.Sprintf(`{"data":{"e%ds":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e%d-r2"}}]}}}`, mid, mid))
	s.want("down a chain", `{ e0s(first: 1) { edges { node { name next { edges { node { name next { edges { node { name } } } } } } } } } }`,
		`{"data":{"e0s":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e0-r1","next":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e1-r1","next":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e2-r1"}}]}}}]}}}]}}}`)
	s.want("up a chain", `{ e9s(first: 1) { edges { node { name prev { name prev { name } } } } } }`,
		`{"data":{"e9s":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e9-r1","prev":{"name":"e8-r1","prev":{"name":"e7-r1"}}}}]}}}`)
	s.want("by ID", fmt.Sprintf(`{ e%ds(where: {id: 2}) { edges { node { id name } } } }`, mid),
		fmt.Sprintf(`{"data":{"e%ds":{"edges":[{"node":{"id":"2","name":"e%d-r2"}}]}}}`, mid, mid))
	s.want("by IDs", fmt.Sprintf(`{ e%ds(where: {idIn: [1, "3"]}) { edges { node { name } } } }`, last),
		fmt.Sprintf(`{"data":{"e%ds":{"edges":[{"node":{"name":"e%d-r1"}},{"node":{"name":"e%d-r3"}}]}}}`, last, last, last))
}

// TestLargeSchemaCostLimits: the limits that do not depend on the schema's size
// hold on a large one: a request that spreads over many root fields is refused
// before any statement runs, and a deep one that stays within its pages is not.
func TestLargeSchemaCostLimits(t *testing.T) {
	s := serve(t)
	// 400 root connections of a full page, over the entities in turn: a request of
	// that width costs the same on any schema, and is past the default MaxCost.
	var flood strings.Builder
	flood.WriteString("{")
	for i := range 400 {
		fmt.Fprintf(&flood, " a%d: e%ds(first: 100) { edges { node { name amount createdAt } } }", i, i%n)
	}
	flood.WriteString(" }")
	if doc, errs := gqlparser.LoadQueryWithRules(schema().Schema(), flood.String(), nil); len(errs) > 0 {
		t.Fatal(errs)
	} else if cost, limit := gqlgenx.Cost(schema().Schema(), doc.Operations[0], nil, veloxgql.Limits{MaxCost: 1 << 40}), veloxgql.DefaultLimits().MaxCost; cost <= limit {
		t.Fatalf("the flood costs %d, within the default MaxCost %d: make it wider", cost, limit)
	}
	if got := s.do(flood.String(), nil); !strings.Contains(got, "COST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED") {
		t.Errorf("400 root connections of 100 rows: %.300s", got)
	}
	// Each page is one row, so the nine levels cost nine statements and a row each.
	deep := "{ e0s(first: 1) { edges { node { name"
	for range 9 {
		deep += " next(first: 1) { edges { node { name"
	}
	deep += strings.Repeat(" } } }", 9) + " } } } }"
	got := s.do(deep, nil)
	if strings.Contains(got, `"errors"`) || !strings.Contains(got, `"name":"e9-r1"`) {
		t.Errorf("nine levels of one row: %.300s", got)
	}
}
